name: Lend-Lease Act
summary: WWII: The United States authorizes massive material aid to countries fighting the Axis.

name: Germany Invades Yugoslavia and Greece
summary: WWII: Germany attacks the Balkans to secure its southern flank before invading the Soviet Union.

name: Battle of Crete
summary: WWII: German airborne forces capture Crete after heavy losses.

name: Operation Barbarossa
summary: WWII: Germany invades the Soviet Union, opening the largest and deadliest land theater of the war.

name: Continuation War Begins
summary: WWII: Finland enters war against the Soviet Union alongside Germany, seeking to recover territory lost in the Winter War.

name: Atlantic Charter
summary: WWII: Roosevelt and Churchill issue principles for the postwar world and Allied cooperation.

name: Siege of Leningrad Begins
summary: WWII: German and Finnish forces isolate Leningrad, beginning a devastating siege.

name: Battle of Moscow
summary: WWII: German forces advance toward Moscow but are halted by Soviet resistance and winter conditions.

name: Attack on Pearl Harbor
summary: WWII: Japan attacks the U.S. Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor, bringing the United States fully into the war.

name: Germany Declares War on the United States
summary: WWII: Nazi Germany declares war on the United States, making the conflict fully global.
